title: Which Superhero Archetype Are You?
description: Every hero has a signature style. Discover whether you save the day with speed, strength, gadgets, heart, or stealth.

answers.text: Routine? Out the door in six minutes flat
Same solid breakfast, every day, no exceptions
Optimized to the minute — you've timed the toaster
Up before everyone, enjoying the quiet
Call before the second text even lands
Reply: 'Coming over. Don't move.'
Send options: call now, dinner later, or both
Already sensed something was up since Tuesday

questions.text: A friend texts 'can you talk?' You:

answers.text: A sturdy desk that's survived three moves

Wherever the people you love happen to be
A corner nook nobody else knows about

answers.text: Being in every conversation at once

Never letting anyone down
Making everyone feel understood
Being full of surprises

results.description: You read the room like a book — and then help everyone in it. Emotional insight is your superpower, and people feel truly seen the moment you show up.
Always prepared, always a step ahead. You out-think problems instead of out-muscling them, and there's a clever solution in your pocket for absolutely everything.
The immovable object, in the best way. Steady, dependable, and fiercely protective, you're the hero everyone wants standing beside them when it counts.
Quiet, observant, and full of surprises. You see everything, say little, and appear exactly where you're needed at exactly the right moment.
Life in the fast lane, permanently. You think fast, move fast, and finish before others start — but your real superpower is the energy you bring everywhere you go.
